categories.summary: The discussion centers on the aftermath of the ai16z/ElizaOS token situation. Shaw Walters explained the project's pivot away from tokens, stating that during the bull market, the team faced exploitation from opportunistic contributors who joined for financial gain rather than genuine contribution. He emphasized that hiring mercenaries rather than committed builders cost more value than they created. Shaw announced the team is now smaller, focused, and moving forward without tokens or "fuckery," with development progressing rapidly. A critical announcement emerged that in early August 2026, Shaw publicly declared the token "dead" following a class-action lawsuit settlement that depleted resources. The foundation is winding down with no further buybacks or token support planned, though the underlying open-source AI agent software development continues. Community members expressed frustration about the token rebranding and subsequent abandonment, with holders seeking clarity on the token's status. Several users pointed out inconsistencies between promoting a rebranded token and then abandoning it months later, leaving holders without closure. Some threatened legal action over significant financial losses. The community debated whether the project truly abandoned the token or if there's potential for recovery. New members joined expressing interest in building Web3 agent tools, while existing members discussed the broader market recovery with "shitters" leading the way. The core technical focus shifted entirely to the open-source software development, decoupled from any token economics.

faqs.question: Is the ElizaOS token completely dead?
Will the GitHub repository continue to receive updates or will it be archived?
What should holders do with their now worthless tokens?

actionItems.description: Remove token links from ElizaOS X handle including Coingecko links and migration/allocation details from Eliza docs
Provide clear closure statement to token holders regarding final status of ai16z/ElizaOS token
Continue development of open-source AI agent software without token integration
